errors.evidence: The description states there are seven categories, but the chart displays only six categories of responses.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва категориите на възприятие
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, meaning the categories are listed on the vertical axis, and the values are represented by the length of the bars along the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly swaps the axes.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва процентното разпределение на всяка категория
errors.evidence: In this horizontal bar chart, the percentage distribution is represented by the length of the horizontal bars, not by the vertical axis. The vertical axis lists the categories.
The description adds the percent sign (%) after each numerical value, but this unit is not explicitly written on the chart itself.
The description mentions the presence of 'легенди' (legends), but the chart does not contain a legend. The categories are directly labeled on the vertical axis.
